name: C_slowpan_720p
notes: One continuous 30.000s take: a 1280px viewport pans across a 2560px panorama (0 -> 1280 px, ~42.7 px/s) while a 'MOVING LABEL' sprite drifts horizontally AND vertically (sin, period 6s) and a burned-in timer ticks. Ground truth has exactly 0 cuts, so any cut reported here is a false positive. Motion is smooth: neighbouring frames differ, which stresses scene detectors that threshold too low.
